dedupe_keys.name: asce hazard tool asce 7 and asce 41 design hazard parameters and api

description: The ASCE Hazard Tool looks up the site design parameters specified in the ASCE/SEI 7 and ASCE/SEI 41 standards for a street address or coordinates, covering wind, tornado, seismic, ice, rain, flood, snow and tsunami loads in one map tool. Users choose the standard edition (ASCE 7-10, 7-16 or 7-22, or ASCE 41-17 or 41-23), risk category, site soil class and units, then view map overlays, details and a plain-text summary or download a PDF report for engineering proposals. An API returns the same data as JSON for the contiguous United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa and the U.S. Virgin Islands, authenticated with an API key and subject to monthly usage limits. Coverage: the United States and its territories. Access: web tool and keyed API; API pricing by quote. Licence: ASCE terms of use. Caveats: values are code design parameters, not site-specific hazard analyses, and each follows its standard edition. Simulation uses are design-level wind, snow and seismic demands for building archetypes and code-based fragility studies. Related records: FEMA Building Code Adoption Tracking and ICC Digital Codes.
